name: suggested-prompts
title: Suggested prompts
description: Ready-made things to ask an AI — chips for follow-ups under an answer, cards for starters on an empty page, a list in a narrow panel. Picking one fills the composer; it never sends.
docs: Ready-made things to ask an AI — chips for follow-ups under an answer, cards for starters on an empty page, a list in a narrow panel. Picking one fills the composer; it never sends. Do: Fill the composer and focus it, so people can edit before sending. Don't: Send the suggestion the moment it is clicked — people lose the chance to adjust it. Do: Use chips under an answer, cards on an empty AI page, and the list in a narrow panel. Don't: Put large starter cards under every answer — they crowd the thread. Use command when people pick from a long, searchable list of actions. Use button when the choice runs an action straight away instead of filling the composer.
